title: Music and dancing as Black heritage
summary: Greer reasserts that rhythm, music and dancing are the Negro heritage.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: They try but it ain't there, baby. It's right. That's our heritage, don't you ever forget. Rhythm, music and dancing, that's our heritage. Don't ever let nobody sell me no soap that the Negroes heritage is picking cotton. Shit, I don't even wear cotton shirts. I wear (inaudible).

That's our heritage. You'd better believe it. They're still -- all this jive they're selling now is a fad. I can't realize -- there's no greater attribute than to be imitated. But it must be good. They're bad.
